bundle.shortDescription: The SQL workbench for Parquet files
bundle.longDescription: ParaSQL is a local-first data workbench for Parquet files. Query folders of Parquet with DuckDB SQL, explore and edit data in a spreadsheet-grade grid with exact undo/redo, build portable multi-file workspaces, and export to Parquet, CSV, JSON, or Excel — all offline, free, and open source.
